✦ About

I make image-led, type-heavy work — sports and pop-culture editorial collage, built from real photography, torn edges, and layered type. Currently a Computer Science student at Newcastle University, applying the same instinct for hierarchy and contrast to web and product design.

Based — Newcastle upon Tyne, UK
Tools — Photoshop, Figma, Canva
Status — Open to part-time / freelance work
Contact — aananditathakur667@gmail.com
